description: This file defines classes and interfaces for reading and processing minidump files, including structures for threads, modules, memory regions, system info, exceptions, and Linux-specific mappings. It serves as a core component of a minidump processing library.

classes.name: Minidump
classes.description: Main interface for reading and accessing minidump file data, including header, streams, and directory entries.

classes.name: MinidumpObject
classes.description: Base class for all minidump-related objects, providing common functionality and ownership management.

classes.name: MinidumpStream
classes.description: Abstract base class for all minidump streams, providing a virtual destructor and a Read method.

classes.name: MinidumpContext
classes.description: Represents CPU-specific context (register states) for a thread or exception.

classes.name: MinidumpMemoryRegion
classes.description: Represents a memory region within a minidump, providing access to its data and properties.

classes.name: MinidumpThread
classes.description: Contains information about a thread, including its stack memory and CPU context.

classes.name: MinidumpThreadList
classes.description: Collection of all threads in the minidump.

classes.name: MinidumpModule
classes.description: Represents a loaded code module, including debug info and identifiers.

classes.name: MinidumpModuleList
classes.description: Collection of all modules loaded in the process at dump time.

classes.name: MinidumpMemoryList
classes.description: List of memory regions contained in the minidump.

classes.name: MinidumpException
classes.description: Contains information about an exception that caused the dump.

classes.name: MinidumpAssertion
classes.description: Contains assertion failure info that triggered the dump.

classes.name: MinidumpSystemInfo
classes.description: Provides system information such as OS and CPU type.

classes.name: MinidumpBreakpadInfo
classes.description: Additional info about the breakpad process at dump time.

classes.name: MinidumpMemoryInfo
classes.description: Information about a specific memory region.

classes.name: MinidumpLinuxMaps
classes.description: Represents a single Linux memory mapping from /proc/self/maps.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the minidump or stream, initializing the object.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a memory region object for a thread or process.

methods.name: GetContext
methods.description: Returns CPU context for a thread or exception.

methods.name: Print
methods.description: Outputs a human-readable representation of the object.

methods.name: GetMemoryAtAddress
methods.description: Reads memory at a specific address within a region.

methods.name: GetModuleForAddress
methods.description: Finds the module containing a specific address.

methods.name: GetStream
methods.description: Template method to retrieve specific stream data.
